sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P2 on Generator, which 
must be performed every six years as indicated by Y6 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. El-Said Mohamed Matarid, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector 
of Damanhour power station, and 
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

items:
Work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear safety helmet, shoes, gloves .... etc
Steam turbine out of service at cold state

Tools and 
Equipment
Device for insertion and removal of rotor
Air blower, special tools as mention at list No
Testers (ohmmeter, voltmeter, ammeter)
500 v megger

Portable direct current voltage test instrument up to a value twice the rated 
voltage of the generator
Revolving mirror or optical fiber endoscope
Halogen leak detector

Equipment for rotor removal (see that it is complete and in good working 
conditions)
Hosting cables for rotor
Complete tool kit for coil winder

2 Hydraulic jacks with associated hand - operated pumps for lifting the 
generator frame (the minimum lifting capacity if each jack shall be at least 
equal to 1/4 the total generator weight)

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Disassemble the upper shields and internal protections to permit visual 
inspection of the stator and rotor end windings with the aid of an optical fiber 
endoscope or revolving mirror
Inspect the bushing terminals and the terminal box through the manholes

Check the insulation by direct current voltage (HV test) to be applied to each 
stator winding phase
Inspect the lubrication plant
Inspect the coolers (which shall be cleaned if necessary)
Check the bearing insulation and seal housing collector end
Check the rotor insulation
Visual inspection of the teflon tubes of the stator end - winding
Inspect the slip ring box

Check the collector rings and reversing of the polarity if required 
inspection of the collector surfaces (and grinding if required)
Check the turbine - generator alignment
Check the instrumentation

Leak test of the casing at the rated pressure to look for and eliminate any gas 
leads inspection of the seal oil unit and of the hydrogen system
Check the stator water coolers
Check the main and make up stator water filters
Check the stator water pumps pressure and temperature regulation valves

All checks and inspections already listed for the three - yearly partial 
overhaul

Remove the rotor (after disassembling of slip ring box shields and internal 
protections)

Inspect and check the stator winding and stator core (fastening of the 
end windings wedging etc)

Inspect and check the rotor (retaining rings keys end windings fan blades 
etc)

sections.text: Removal of Exciter
Remove the exciter housing including the collector brush rigging
Disconnect all oil lines protecting the openings against entrance of dirt

Disconnect all electrical connections pushing the cable ends below the floor 
line if possible
Remove all bolts and dowels holding the exciter base to the foundation
Check to see that all parts are free and that no interference exists

sections.text: Disassembly of Rotor
Remove brush - holder rigging and complete direct connected exciter
Remove the coward (side the turbine)
Remove the outside air shield rings and outside shields
Remove the inside air shield rings and inside air shields
Remove the pedestal cop. Oil deflectors and bearing lining
Place a jacking device or support under the coupling end of the rotor

sections.text:
Program for removal or 
insertion of the Rotor

items:
Insert sliding plate. You see the fig 1- 
 item 1, fix the sliding plate on the rotor fan hubs in 12 O'clock position 
 pull through the stator bar the sling (item 2, fig. 1) by using the copper 
 wire

Insert the sliding plate on the tensed sling 
 between the supports (item 4 fig 1) in the upper position when fitted remove 
 the sling (item 2 fig 1) and the adjusting screws (item 3 fig 1) press at both 
 ends the sliding plate with the supports (item 4 fig 1 ) to the erection 
 device turn the rotor until the sliding plate is reaching the 6 O'clock 
 position loosen, the screws (item 5 fig1) until the sliding plate lays in the 
 stator bar. Remove supports (item 4 fig 1 ) at driving side

Fix the inter - mediate piece (item 7 fig 2) 
 for the sliding pad on the fan hubs at driving end in the 12 O'clock 
 position

Turn the rotor until the inter - mediate piece 
 is reaching the position of the sliding plate : by the same, the same, the 
 sliding plate erection device has turned again in the 12 O'clock position and 
 can now be removed

Dismantle bearing brackets and upper bearing 
 parts

Mount the lifting jack (item 8 fig 2) at the B 
 end

Lift the rotor as high as possible using the 
 crane at A end and the lifting jack at B end, make sure that the rotor does 
 not touch the stator windings and iron core

Pull two lengths of string through the stator 
 bar and use them to pull the sliding pad (item 9 fig 2) from the B end to the 
 A end (to keep connect the air pipe line to the B end) the distance between 
 the pad and the end of the stator iron core should be at 150 mm

Put the second sliding pad (item 10 fig 2) 
 unclear the fan hub with the inter mediate piece (to keep connect the air pipe 
 line to the A end)

Lower the rotor at both ends until the A end 
 lies on the pad (item 9 fig 2) in this position the rotor is 1.5 mm above the 
 center line)

With the aid of the crane, dismantle the lower 
 bearing shell and the bearing rings at both ends

Assemble bearing pedestal, bracket and two - 
 paet ring (item 11) with threaded bolts (item 12) and nuts (item 13) to the 
 rotor shaft at the B end (all items Nos. refer to (fig 2 section c-c)

Change on B end of the rotor from the lifting 
 jack to the crane sling then check with a spirit level that the rotor remains 
 at horizontal position

Open the compressed air valve and take out the 
 rotor with slight lateral movements advancing the crane accordingly

sections.text: Attention

items:
Watch the second 
 sliding pad (item 10 fig 2 ) as soon as this pad is full contact with the 
 stator core, the connection to the air supply must be changed over

Continue the withdraw 
 of the rotor until its center of gravity has approx reached the midpoint of 
 the bearing pedestal support the gravity center line is approx 250 mm besides 
 of the rotor midpoint i.e. the slot wedges centering screws

Lower the rotor on the 
 wooden support (item 14 fig 3) and set down the sling on the bearing pedestal 
 support

Dismantle lifting jack 
 at the B end with the crane

Lift the rotor with 
 the sling and carefully pull it right out of the stator bore
